Name: Cuter Crops and Foraging
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
This mod retextures the crops and forageable items in Stardew to be a bit more cute and colorful. Pumpkins are white, cauliflower is now light purple, melon is a watermelon slice and just overall cute vibes going on here.

I used Cometkins “Better Crops and Foraging” as a base for this mod (they provide permission to everyone [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912?tab=posts]HERE[/url]) and then a lot of the artwork is modified from Pixerelia’s awesome work on [url=https://pixerelia.itch.io/]itchio[/url]. I tried to add my own little cute flair to things so I hope you like it! I’m still new to modding so I want to improve as I go along and add the things I didn’t retexture (like flowers) but in the meantime I hope this adds some cuteness to your game!  

After installing it should generate a config file so you can turn on/off whatever items you want to.


[color=#ead1dc][size=5][b][i]2.0 update![/i][/b][/size][/color]
Better flowers, new sprites, improved saturation/contrast!

I reworked several sprites and overhauled the flowers because I wasn't happy with them. Much thanks to Pixerelia who I commissioned for that fairy rose!! Colors/overall palette is more saturated and has better contrast so things should be easier to see and work better together. Cuter Artisan Goods will be getting a similar update in the future. :)

Other mods visible in the screenshots include [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks.[/url]
